mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_NoSelfApproval allows Alloy to construct a world where a PatchStatus operation succeeds even though the caller is the same user as the application's applicant — the self-approval conflict-of-interest violation that FCA framing requires cannot happen.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_SelfApprovalViolation { some op : Operation, a : LoanApplication | op.opKind = PatchStatus and op.opOutcome = Success and op.opTarget = a and op.opCaller = a.appApplicant }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_AppendOnlyAuditEntries lets Alloy invent two distinct AuditEntries for the same application that share an identical (prevStatus, newStatus) pair — the hallmark of an in-place update or duplicated replay that the append-only invariant is designed to catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some disj ae1, ae2 : AuditEntry | ae1.auditApp = ae2.auditApp and ae1.auditPrevStatus = ae2.auditPrevStatus and ae1.auditNewStatus = ae2.auditNewStatus }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_AuditCompleteness allows a LoanApplication to exist with no AuditEntry at all — violating the invariant that every observable state change must have a corresponding audit record (SC-002, SC-008).
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditMissingViolation { some a : LoanApplication | no ae : AuditEntry | ae.auditApp = a }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_PermissionMatrix lets Alloy assign arbitrary allow-cells to the PermMatrix, including granting Auditor access to PatchStatus or Applicant access to GetAudit, breaking every LeastPrivilege and role-isolation assertion.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PermMatrixViolation { RAuditor -> PatchStatus in PermMatrix.Allowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_RoleMutualExclusivity allows Alloy to construct a User who simultaneously holds both Officer and Auditor roles, violating the data-model constraint that these two bank-staff roles are mutually exclusive.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_RoleMutexViolation { some u : User | ROfficer in u.userRoles and RAuditor in u.userRoles }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_NoInformationLeakage allows a non-owner applicant's GET to succeed on an application they don't own, meaning the system distinguishes 'exists but not yours' from 'does not exist' — precisely the privacy invariant FR-020/FR-021 forbids.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeakageViolation { some op : Operation, a : LoanApplication | op.opKind = GetAppById and op.opCallerRole = RApplicant and op.opTarget = a and op.opCaller != a.appApplicant and op.opOutcome = Success }
